motion.name: service-arrow

motion.name: button-state
motion.value: background 180ms ease, border-color 180ms ease, transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)
motion.purpose: Inherited button feedback; active scale is 0.98.

motion.name: hero-title-tracking
motion.purpose: One clinic-name entrance without delay, paired with the photo aperture. Tracking starts at -0.18em and ends at existing -0.04em desktop / -0.035em mobile spacing; opacity starts at 0, reaches 0.6 at 40%, and ends at 1. Adapted from Animista's tracking-in concept; other text remains static.

reducedMotion.behavior: Clinic-name tracking and photo animations, plus chevron/arrow transitions, are disabled. Global CSS disables all animations/transitions, smooth scrolling and button active scaling. Content remains visible through plain server wrappers.

responsive.behavior: Major spread gaps become 48px; primary clinic photo minimum height becomes 340px; cover locality line takes a full row.

Container gutters become 20px. Name is two block spans at clamp(48px, 12.6vw, 88px), second inset 17%. Photo is 300px high and bleeds into gutters. Main content splits stack; service heading stops sticking. Clinic photos use 1fr/104px with a 12px gap and 280px/240px minimum heights. Fields become 16px. Form gap becomes 22px.

Cover photo becomes 270px high. Clinic photos stack; smaller photograph is 64% wide, right-aligned, 180px minimum height. Service leading icons disappear; booking grid becomes one column. Regular section headings are 32px; clinic photo heading is 34px.

focus.purpose: Inherited keyboard focus with pale outline on the forest cover.

extensions.depth: No home-module box-shadow tokens; depth comes from forest/paper/sage layering, photography, offset composition and dividers.
extensions.notCanonized: Retained section-context labels and the very small cover locality line are not reusable typography roles; ordinary shared control colors are documented as inherited behavior rather than a whole-site replacement.

fontPairing.delivery: Local Fontsource assets with Cyrillic and font-display: swap

narrative.overview:
This metaphor and the descriptive color names are builder choices under the user's autonomous art-direction request, not user-approved wording. This record describes the shipped homepage content inside its scoped wrapper. The source of truth is `src/app/home.module.css`, its composition is `src/app/page.tsx`, and inherited control behavior comes from `src/app/globals.css`. The existing `DESIGN.md` and `.impeccable/design.json` continue to govern the shared header, footer and other routes.

The homepage uses a forest cover, generous Nunito Sans lettering and a rectangular photograph of the actual clinic's animals. Paper reading sections alternate with sage spreads. Thin rules organize services and practical information; authentic entrance and pharmacy photographs establish the place. Existing phrases, facts, source attribution and booking behavior remain binding product commitments from `PRODUCT.md`.
keyCharacteristics: Large locally hosted Nunito Sans lettering above a continuous photographic field.
Forest, paper and sage sections with flat surfaces and ruled lists.
Native disclosures, explicit booking confirmation and real clinic photographs.
One opening sequence pairs clinic-name tracking with the photo aperture; reduced motion presents both statically.

rules.name: The Scope Rule
rules.body: Apply these tokens inside the homepage wrapper; preserve the incumbent whole-site system for the shared shell and other routes.

rules.name: The Type Rule
rules.body: Keep the clinic-name and homepage section-heading roles in locally hosted Manrope; the inherited serif display system belongs to the other routes.

dos: Do keep the forest cover, paper reading surface and sage spreads scoped to the homepage.
Do retain locally hosted Manrope, real clinic photographs, source attribution and existing copy.
Do preserve native disclosures, visible keyboard focus and the static reduced-motion presentation.
Do preserve the clinic's confirmation requirement and the honest absence of published prices, hours, doctor profiles and verified reviews.
donts: Don't apply this scoped homepage record to the shared shell or other routes.
Don't invent tonal ramps, shadow tokens, proof, clinic facts or replacement product wording.
Don't present the builder's metaphor or descriptive names as user-approved language.
Don't turn the retained section-context labels or the very small cover location line into reusable display roles; they carry existing copy and are not canonized as homepage typography tokens.
